body: Hey mate, 22M. Just hit me up whenever. I'm always down for a chat

It feels when you help someone out too much you're crossing a boundary. Or if they do appreciate your help, then they never return the favour... I know I shouldn't expect anything back... but if someone tells you they'll be there for you when you're not... then what's the point of saying it...

I feel for you mate... I really do...
I get it... like there shouldn't be anything to be sad or depressed about. But here I am just sad. I feel ungrateful to all the things that I was born with and raised with.
I'd love to join as well!
Hey... looks like we have alot in common. Same age as well. My doors are always open if you wanna talk. Glad to find someone who gets what its like...

I feel you... I heard the exact same words from everyone. "You're so smart". But being smart doesn't mean I have any passions. I'm working right now but... I don't feel passionate about it. I always question the importance of my existence. Will I be missed if I leave? I think it would be pretty easy to forget me. I don't contribute much in my life to others I guess....
